plan: A mage who roots with her sphere of light and finishes off from very far with her laser beam.
aSurveiller: Her Q (Light Binding). It roots you, then she follows up with her R: dodge the sphere and her combo no longer works.
contrer: Keep at least two minions between her and you: her sphere (Q) stops after two targets.
Engage her up close: she is fragile and has no escape spell.
After a missed Q, she is vulnerable for several seconds: time to attack.
forces: Very long-range damage with her R.
Her Q roots up to two targets.
Protects her allies with her W.
faiblesses: Slow spells that are easy to dodge.

sorts.P: Her spells mark the target; her next attack hurts more.
sorts.Q: Sphere that roots up to two enemies.

momentFort: Dangerous from level 6 with her R, especially in the mid game.
